$comment: Single source of truth for the published artifact identity. Changing name/version after the first publish changes frozen CDN URLs, so decide before releasing.
name: discord-transcript-ui
description: Dependency-free, light-DOM custom elements and one stylesheet for rendering Discord chat transcripts in plain HTML.

cdn.note: Primary. npm-derived, immutable-cached with an exact version, supports SRI.
